workflows.name: Quarterly Cooperative Purchase Volume Accumulation Audit

Automation Opportunity: - Quarterly sales extraction scripts compiling co-op accounts data.
Controls: - CTL-787 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Rebate & Purchase Volume Reconciliation (PA-185.3).)
- operational: Month-end control standards; Chief Accountant audit validation.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Overpayment of rebates risk**: Calculating rebates on gross sales before deducting returns, causing margin erosion; mitigated by using net sales figures (excluding returns and taxes) for calculations.
System Touchpoints: - General Ledger (VS-17), Accounts Receivable module, Reporting system.

steps.activity: Extract all closed invoice data associated with cooperative parent and child accounts.
Deduct returned items, cancelled orders, and disputed transactions.
Reconcile transaction values against bank receipts and cash collections.
Compile Quarterly Consolidated Sales Report.

workflows.name: Cooperative Patronage Dividend Tax Certification & Accounting

Automation Opportunity: - Automated BIR Cas tax exemption classification rules applied to co-op account classes.
Controls: - CTL-787 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Rebate & Purchase Volume Reconciliation (PA-185.3).)
- operational: Month-end control standards; Tax Director final audit clearance.
Pain Points / Risks: - **BIR audit penalty risk**: Granting tax-exempt rebates to unregistered or non-compliant cooperatives; mitigated by verifying valid CDA tax-exemption certificate files (W5299).
System Touchpoints: - BIR CAS Tax Module (VS-79), General Ledger (VS-17).

steps.activity: Calculate tax treatment of patronage rebates.
Prepare tax certificate verifying tax-exempt status of rebate disbursement.
Log tax exemptions in quarterly BIR tax reporting module.
Post rebate accrual journal entry in General Ledger.

workflows.name: Rebate Credit Memo Issuance and Voucher Disbursement

Automation Opportunity: - Automated credit memo generation and bank transfer processing.
Controls: - CTL-787: ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Rebate & Purchase Volume Reconciliation (PA-185.3). — finance authorization controls; Finance Manager sign-off required for disbursements > PHP 500k.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double disbursement risk**: Rebates applied as credit memo and also paid out in cash; mitigated by matching credit memos to unique voucher reference codes in ERP.
System Touchpoints: - General Ledger (VS-17), Accounts Payable module (VS-15), Cash Book (VS-18).

steps.activity: Issue formal Credit Memo in ERP linked to cooperative parent account.
Apply credit to open invoice balances per co-op preference.
Transfer rebate funds to cooperative central bank account or issue cash voucher code.
Collect signed acknowledgement receipt from cooperative treasurer.

workflows.name: Joint Cooperative Community Build Project Procurement Scoping

Automation Opportunity: - Shared design collaboration dashboard for project tracking.
Controls: - CTL-787 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Rebate & Purchase Volume Reconciliation (PA-185.3).)
- operational: Capex authorization controls; Head of Trade / Account Management approval on special discounts.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope-creep risk**: Community build projects run over budget due to unmanaged changes in material lists; mitigated by freezing project blueprints before purchase order release.

steps.activity: Meet with cooperative board to define community build project: dimensions, materials, budget.
Develop project blueprint specifications and Bill of Quantities (BOQ).
Apply special cooperative corporate discounts to material list; compile price quote.
Present quote and project timeline to co-op board for approval.

workflows.name: Cooperative Social Fund Contribution Routing & CSR Verification

Automation Opportunity: - Automated donation audit log linking social fund releases directly to project numbers.
Controls: - CTL-787 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Rebate & Purchase Volume Reconciliation (PA-185.3).)
- operational: Month-end control standards; Foundation Director approval on social fund routing.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misallocated donation risk**: Contribution funds diverted to unapproved uses, violating BIR donee rules; mitigated by requiring detailed project invoices for all fund releases.

steps.activity: Calculate BuildRight social contribution portion.
Verify compliance of donation with BIR tax deductibility rules.
Route contribution payment to joint project escrow account or directly to supplier.
Compile project completion report with photographs and submit to Board CSR Committee.

workflows.name: Annual Cooperative General Assembly Partnership Review

- operational: finance risk controls; Head of Trade / Account Management briefing sign-off before assemblies.

Pain Points / Risks: - **Public relation fallout risk**: Dissatisfaction among co-op members regarding store operations goes unaddressed, leading to account loss; mitigated by attending general assemblies and responding to feedback.

Attend cooperative Annual General Assembly meeting.
Address member feedback regarding customer service, pricing, and material availability.

fields.Participants: Financial Analyst, B2B Head of Trade / Account Management

workflows.name: Cooperative Partnership Performance Analytics and Scorecard Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - Automated dashboard showing cooperative performance metrics updated daily.
Controls: - CTL-787 (ensure controlled execution — Cooperative Rebate & Purchase Volume Reconciliation (PA-185.3).)
- operational: Month-end control standards; Head of Trade / Account Management audit review.
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (data analytics), VS-17 (finance), VS-67 (scorecard)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unprofitable customer maintenance risk**: Continuing partnerships with cooperatives that generate low margins and high credit collection costs; mitigated by comparing coop margins against cost of credit.

steps.activity: Extract past-year metrics.
Compile Cooperative Performance Scorecard ranking partners by profitability and volume.
Analyze regional co-op purchasing patterns to identify product margin growth opportunities.
Present Scorecard to B2B Head of Trade / Account Management and category teams.
